question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The students were asked to __assemble__ in the meeting hall.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dispersed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"assemble"** means to gather together in one place for a common purpose. (इकट्ठा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The students were asked to **assemble **in the meeting hall.
 
 
 
• **"Dispersed"** refers to the act of distributing or spreading over a wide area; scattering. (फैलाना)
 
 
• **Example:** After the meeting, the crowd **dispersed **quickly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'assemble'** is **'dispersed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Put together** (एक साथ रखना): To place different items or elements together.

 
 
• **Example:** She **put together** a scrapbook of their vacation photos.
 
 
 
• **Collect** (संग्रह करना): To gather or bring things together.
 
 
• **Example:** He likes to **collect **stamps from different countries.
 
 
 
• **Gather** (इकट्ठा करना): To bring together or come together in one place.
 
 
• **Example:** The children **gathered **around the storyteller.
